display_name: Bhima I and the Somnath Defenders
one_line: Chaulukya king Bhima I of Gujarat, imagined as the embattled ruler sending stalwart defenders to Somnath during Mahmud of Ghazni’s 1025–1026 raid.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, tall and broad-shouldered with a sturdy warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a straight nose, sharp jawline, medium-brown wheatish complexion, neatly trimmed moustache and short boxed beard, calm but intense eyes with a default expression of restrained determination and worry.
appearance.hair: Thick, black hair gathered into a medium-length topknot at the back of the head, sides smoothed and oiled; a simple dark-red cloth paag (turban) wrapped low, with a narrow gold border and a small central tilak mark visible on the forehead beneath it.
appearance.costume: Era-appropriate Chaulukya-Gujarat royal attire: a knee-length, long-sleeved angarakha in muted cream cotton with a subtle diamond-weave texture, wrapped left-over-right and tied with visible cloth ties; over it a sleeveless, waist-length quilted war-vest in deep maroon with thin gold piping and simple stitched patterns suggesting padded protection; a broad woven cloth kamarband in dark indigo with thin white stripes cinching the waist and holding a sheathed sword; lower body clothed in loose off-white churidar-style trousers gathered neatly at the ankles; feet in brown leather sandals with simple straps; modest jewellery limited to a pair of small gold stud earrings, a single plain gold bangle on the right wrist, and a thread necklace with a small, understated metal pendant, all keeping him dignified but not ostentatious as a king under threat.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved, single-edged early medieval Indian sword (talwar precursor) with a plain iron hilt, short crossguard, and simple round pommel, sheathed at his left hip in a brown leather scabbard with minimal metal fittings, often held resting in his right hand by the scabbard throat.

ref_desc: Bhima I is a tall, broad-shouldered man in his early 30s with a wheatish oval face, black hair in a topknot under a dark-red gold-trimmed turban, wearing a cream angarakha, maroon quilted war-vest, off-white trousers, indigo kamarband, brown sandals, modest gold jewellery, and a plain curved sword in a brown leather scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model sheet of Bhima I of Gujarat in 1025–1026 CE: a tall, broad-shouldered man in his early 30s with a wheatish oval face, straight nose, sharp jawline, trimmed moustache and short boxed beard, and calm but intense eyes; his thick black hair is gathered into a medium topknot and wrapped with a simple dark-red cloth turban that has a narrow gold border, a small tilak mark visible on his forehead beneath it. He wears a knee-length, long-sleeved cream cotton angarakha with subtle diamond-weave texture, wrapped left-over-right and tied with visible cloth ties, over which sits a sleeveless, waist-length deep maroon quilted war-vest with thin gold piping and stitched patterns suggesting padding; his waist is cinched with a broad dark indigo cloth kamarband with thin white stripes, from which hangs a slightly curved single-edged sword in a plain brown leather scabbard with minimal metal fittings at his left hip. His lower body is covered by loose off-white churidar-style trousers gathered neatly at the ankles, and he wears brown leather sandals with simple straps; jewellery is modest—a pair of small gold stud earrings, a single plain gold bangle on his right wrist, and a simple thread necklace with a small metal pendant. Show him in multiple views (front, side, back) holding or resting his hand on the scabbarded sword, with colours clearly visible, capturing a dignified, historically grounded ruler sending defenders to Somnath.
